start.title: [TODO:de] Sons of the Soil
start.text:
[TODO:de] You are Cain, firstborn of Adam.
Your brother Abel walks beside you in the dawn.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] He smiles. The morning feels lighter.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Compare yourself to him in silence
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] A quiet bitterness takes root.
[TODO:de] He calls your name. You do not turn.

fields.title: [TODO:de] The Tiller of Soil
fields.text:
[TODO:de] The earth resists your hoe.
Sweat. Stones. The long hours of work.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The labor settles your heart.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Curse the ground as you dig
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Each strike grows angrier than the last.

abel_pasture.title: [TODO:de] Your Brother's Flock
abel_pasture.text:
[TODO:de] Abel rests among his sheep, content.
A newborn lamb sleeps on his chest.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Be glad for his gentle work
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Warmth rises where envy could have grown.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Resent that his work seems easy
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your jaw tightens. Comparison poisons the day.
[TODO:de] Your words stay quiet, but they sting your own soul.

offerings.title: [TODO:de] Before the Altar
offerings.text:
[TODO:de] It is time to bring an offering to the Lord.
What will you give?

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You choose the finest grain. Your heart is open.
[TODO:de] Wilted stalks. Half a thought toward heaven.
[TODO:de] Empty hands. A harder, prouder heart.

accepted.title: [TODO:de] The Lord's Favor
accepted.text:
[TODO:de] The Lord receives Abel's lamb with joy.
Your offering — He does not regard.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You ask why. The answer is already in you.
[TODO:de] Heat floods your chest. He becomes your enemy.
[TODO:de] Your fist rises. The sky does not answer.

anger.title: [TODO:de] Why Are You Angry?
anger.text:
[TODO:de] Your face falls. Your hands shake.
The Lord asks: "Why are you angry?"

choices.text: [TODO:de] Lay your anger down before Him
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The fire begins to cool. Honesty opens a path.
[TODO:de] You hide your face. He still sees.

warning.title: [TODO:de] Sin Crouches at the Door
warning.text:
[TODO:de] "Sin is crouching at your door.
Its desire is for you — but you must master it."

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] You exhale. You will choose differently.
[TODO:de] You open the door wide. Sin walks in.
[TODO:de] The warning fades. The hatred remains.

invitation.title: [TODO:de] Come With Me to the Field
invitation.text:
[TODO:de] Abel walks toward you, trusting.
His face is open. Yours is not.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Tell him the truth of your heart
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Words are hard. But honesty is mercy.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Lure him alone into the field
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] Your voice is calm. Your intent is not.

field.title: [TODO:de] In the Field
field.text:
[TODO:de] The field is empty. No one will see.
Anger surges. A stone is in your hand.

choices.feedback: [TODO:de] It falls heavy at your feet. You breathe again.
[TODO:de] One blow. Then silence. Then horror.
[TODO:de] Your hand obeys the rage. The field receives him.

confrontation.title: [TODO:de] "Where Is Your Brother?"
confrontation.text:
[TODO:de] The voice of the Lord finds you.
"Where is your brother Abel?"

choices.text: [TODO:de] Confess what your hands have done
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] The truth crushes you. And begins to free you.
[TODO:de] The lie tastes like ash in your mouth.

choices.text: [TODO:de] Stay silent and hide your eyes
choices.feedback: [TODO:de] His blood cries out from the ground.

wanderer.title: [TODO:de] East of Eden, Marked
wanderer.text:
[TODO:de] The Lord places a mark to protect you.
You must wander far from home.
